status: development informed by v3-v9 outcomes; not preregistered independent confirmation
algorithm: Within each contiguous stream compute centered, clipped moving means of local T,R,F at fixed window lengths. Jointly normalize each stream for numerical stability, apply the same fractional power to all three components and form original hndi. Average local contrasts over every retained observation. Fuse its train-median/IQR asinh score with independently normalized original uHNDI, with inner-selected eta. At eta=0 exactly preserve the original score ordering. No learned feature coefficients or population-based feature extraction.
moving_window: At position i within a segment use [max(0,i-floor(w/2)),min(L,i+floor((w-1)/2)+1)); do not shift, pad, or join gaps. A window larger than the available segment clips to actual observations. These are observation counts, not equivalent physical durations across modalities.
selection: Mean three-inner-fold AUC; ties within 1e-12 prefer original anchor, then smaller eta, window and power=1 before power=.5. All calibration and model choices fit only training patients. Primary has25 candidates; distribution-only9; no-power13; target-anchor and shuffled25.
shuffled_control: One fixed joint permutation of local T/R/F triples inside each contiguous segment. Preserve all values, local component relationships and gap structure; only ordering changes. Not a permutation p-value or a promoted model.
binder: Reconstruct all published envelope samples separately for each available original channel Fz,FC1,FCz,FC2,C1,Cz,C2 from aggregate ITPC using offsets [-.05,.10]. Per-channel T is late [.20,.35] trajectory; R is mean envelope[-.30,-.05]; F is mean envelope[.02,.15]. Repeat channel R/F over its late trajectory, never connect channels. All three pooled means must reproduce original components. Adjacent samples overlap under the exported500ms time-frequency window; no precise-latency, independent-trial or raw-voltage claims.
wielek: Per epoch T=indicator(N1), R=0, F=indicator(wake or N3). Contiguous segments respect record label and consecutive epoch time. N2/REM contribute genuine all-zero component epochs, defined contrast0. Window1,power1 equals rawT exactly. No eye/video, CRS-R, diagnosis or missingness metadata enters the primary algorithm.
mendeley: Chronological original clean4s blocks: T=theta4-8Hz density,R=alpha8-13Hz density,F=0. Verify each v3cache SHA; accept peak<=500uV with original channel reference and Welch implementation. Artifact gaps break segments. All41 retained subjects and original duplicate exclusion unchanged. Both pooled component means must match nominal baseline.
quality_control: Separate negative-control classifier inputs: log1p number observations, log1p number segments, fraction valid adjacent links, retained fraction when available. These do not enter primary or same-input comparators. Interpretation explicitly concerns recording/selection patterns, not physiological information.
classical_inputs: T, originaluHNDI, and all six window/power pooled scores, exactly the primary's measurable inputs. Logistic C=[.1,1,10], auto-shrinkageLDA, RF depth=[2,3,null], n_estimators200,min_leaf3,max_features=sqrt. Training-only scaling/fit/tuning. Quality-only uses its four inputs and same LR grid.
metric: Arithmetic mean outer-fold AUC then equal cohort macro, all five seeds and adverse results retained
performance_target: Positive macro delta over both T and originaluHNDI at every seed and positive five-seed mean delta over both in every cohort. Temporal-specific benefit additionally requires positive mean macro delta over distribution_only_pool and shuffled_pool; report separately, do not condition overall success on this specific mechanism.
limits: Power pooling and moving-window contrast are established operations, not claimed as unprecedented inventions. This is a candidate shared aggregation algorithm requiring empirical incremental benefit. Common component gain invariance holds for fixed observations and scaled component triples, not for reapplying absolute artifact rejection. No superiority or clinical gain guaranteed; all prior sources/results/manuscripts remain byte-protected.
